scientific_integrity: Uniform proof using neighborhood incidence, discrete Morse dimension reduction, an established fundamental-group theorem, integral Euler characteristic, and exact Lefschetz/Fourier formulas. Independently structured finite computations verify cases in dimensions three, five and seven; they are not infinite proofs. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only odd dimensions at least three, open neighborhoods, rational homology, and the translation subgroup; no integral representation lattice or full equivariant homotopy classification. Absolute bibliographic priority cannot be certified from indexed searches.
title: Translation-character decomposition for odd folded-cube neighborhood complexes
